content_data.meeting_title: AR Rendering Pipeline Optimization & Unity Integration Review
agenda_items: Review API architecture for real-time data synchronization across devices
Address WebXR deployment strategy for client demo environment
key_decisions: Migrate to Unity 6 rendering pipeline within the next 3 months to leverage improved AR Foundation features
Adopt Manomotion SDK for hand tracking rather than building custom solution in-house
action_items: Conduct performance profiling on current spatial mesh generation algorithm by end of week
Document API endpoints and data schemas for client integration by next sprint
